decisions.reason: As a newly launched offer that fits the firm's cloud, contact-centre and digital-transformation direction, it is still an attractive option to keep open because uncertainty remains high and there is no clear negative signal yet.

This routing platform is close to the firm's core voice and connectivity capabilities, and for a large expanding telecom provider the cost of keeping such a new, complementary service on the market is likely lower than the value of preserving its growth option while demand becomes clearer.
